headline.text: Label printer system failed at *10:05* across all three plants — hardware replacement underway, estimated *3-5 hours* to restore.

per_plant_summary.L1: L1 ran through brown sugar and Celtic salt shortages with workarounds. Sollich 3 lost an hour at startup fixing decorator speed and frozen nozzles but recovered. Sollich 4 had a 12-minute vacuum cleaning stop.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML3 demolding plate came off its bracket at 02:18 — maintenance replaced hardware and had the line back by 05:19. FFS ran clean after a planned blade cleaning. Vacuum filter found packed with chocolate buildup.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML1 stopped for 2 hours to replace 43 broken conveyor links and worn sprockets. ML4 saw 26+ preheating faults through the day — maintenance troubleshooting recurring issue. MFM started with underweight pouches, corrected and running.

notes.text: Brown sugar delivered at 09:27 after overnight substitute approval; Celtic salt (300 lbs) arriving Thursday morning.
Board tour completed at 09:11 — plant was clean, organized, and ML4 impressed visitors.

resolved.title: S3 decorator startup failure
resolved.summary: Decorator wouldn't start after changeover — speed set too high at 285, then chocolate nozzle pins frozen shut from cold chocolate.
resolved.resolution: Lowered speed to 150 to start, raised back to 285. Torched nozzles to free pins. Good temper and running by 16:11.

resolved.title: Brown sugar shortage overnight
resolved.summary: Three Sollich lines exhausted brown sugar supply with no delivery — stopped cooking at 17:29 until substitute approved.
resolved.resolution: Quality and leadership approved Non-GMO brown sugar substitute at 17:58. Cooking resumed. Delivery arrived 09:27.

resolved.title: S1 chiller compressor fault
resolved.summary: Chiller #2 faulted overnight with low pressure, likely due to cold ambient temp and fans running at 100%.
resolved.resolution: Reset successfully at 19:53. Maintenance planning temporary fan control solution.

resolved.title: S4 vacuum system transfer delay
resolved.summary: Vacuum transfer to kettles running slow, risking additional stops — 12-minute pause at 09:50 to clean mixing tank and filter.
resolved.resolution: Cleaned filter and mixing tank. Total process took 12 minutes, line resumed.

resolved.title: ML3 demolding plate bracket failure
resolved.summary: Turning plate came off bracket at 02:18, stopping the line for 3 hours while maintenance replaced bracket and rail slides with new hardware.
resolved.resolution: New plate installed and adjusted by 05:19 — "Line is running, plate is moving smooth" (Gustavo Rodas).

resolved.title: ML2 flow wrapper door sensor faults
resolved.summary: Multiple door sensor faults stopped the line at 03:04 — sensor behind door was loose, then main door sensor faulted.
resolved.resolution: Tightened loose sensor, performed hard resets. "Start line" at 03:34 (ML2 FW).

resolved.title: ML1 U-shaped conveyor broken links
resolved.summary: Conveyor kept stopping due to 43 damaged links causing noise and jams, line down from 10:36 while maintenance replaced links and worn sprockets.
resolved.resolution: 43 links replaced and sprockets swapped by 13:54 — "no more clicking noise" (Nathan Ruiz). Line resumed at 12:48.

resolved.title: MFM underweight pouches at startup
resolved.summary: Pouches rejecting for low weight at 15:07 start — counts showed 8-10 caramel pieces instead of target, left side underweight.
resolved.resolution: Shawn adjusted Yamato. Line restarted at 15:55 — "i think we're good" (Shawn Jewkes).

needs_attention.title: Label printer system outage across all plants
needs_attention.summary: All three Lindon locations lost ability to print FG and case labels at ~10:05 due to server hardware failure.
needs_attention.status: IT working hardware replacement and data migration. Estimated 3-5 hours for fix as of 12:02 (Goose Fredrikson, Chad Stone).

needs_attention.title: Celtic salt inventory critically low
needs_attention.summary: Only salt remaining is what's on the S3 line — estimated 5 hours remaining as of 12:30, with 1.5 bags left.
needs_attention.status: Cooking stopped at 12:31 to preserve salt. 300 lbs arriving Thursday morning, 200 lbs Friday 11/20 (Martin Carlos 13:35).

needs_attention.title: S3 walkway roof leak
needs_attention.summary: Significant leak reported in middle of Sollich 4 walkway at 17:03 — water pooling on floor.
needs_attention.status: William Lopez committed to check next day. "Luckily it will not rain" (20:45).

needs_attention.title: Heavy cream shortage projected through Friday
needs_attention.summary: Need 4,300 gallons from now through Friday 3rd shift but only have 3,300 gallons on hand — 1,000 gallon shortfall.
needs_attention.status: Reported to Kirk Nickel at 12:48. No delivery ETA provided in window.

needs_attention.title: Foreign product found in ingredient super sacks
needs_attention.summary: Second consecutive night finding foreign items inside ingredient sacks — cherry kisses tonight, pretzels last night.
needs_attention.status: Reported to Jose, Alan, Hervin. No corrective action documented in window.

needs_attention.title: ML2 vacuum filter packed with chocolate
needs_attention.summary: Vacuum elbow and filter found full of chocolate causing flow-outs on wrapper — both top and filter heavily contaminated with milk and white mix.
needs_attention.status: Dave Ruff cleaned at 07:48. Recommended daily 20-minute cleaning plus deep clean Fridays. Hasn't been cleaned properly "for a while."

needs_attention.title: ML4 WDS recurring preheating faults
needs_attention.summary: WDS stopped 15 times for Preheating 2 since start of shift, then 11 more stops between 12:19-12:29 — persistent issue.
needs_attention.status: Blake Heward checking preheating 2 as of 12:42. Ray Garcia asked about re-racking the card — new module won't deliver today.
